package.name: bag_slam_bridge
package.description: Bridges a rosbag's own SLAM (LIO odometry + TF tree) onto the SysNav interface topics /registered_scan and /state_estimation, so the full stack can run without a second SLAM (arise_slam). Registers the raw LiDAR into the bag's world frame via TF and republishes the LIO pose. Sibling of arise_slam_mid360 — it produces the same two topics the whole stack consumes.
